Mobile screens: useState for data/loading/refreshing/error, useCallback for load functions, useEffect triggers load, RefreshControl on FlatList/ScrollView. Theme: colors from `../../theme/colors`, spacing from `../../theme/spacing`, typography.makeTextStyle(size, weight, color). Components: AppHeader (title, showBack, onBack, rightAction), AppButton (title, onPress, variant, loading), ConfirmDialog (visible, title, message, confirmText, onConfirm, onCancel, destructive), BookingCard (booking, onPress), StatusBadge (status), LoadingView (message), EmptyState (iconName, title, subtitle, actionLabel, onAction).
